description: Rotate the supplied approved south-facing robot sprite into the four cardinal directions. Preserve this same compact boxlike subject, its proportions and its source palette. Keep the supplied south frame unchanged. Preserve its two upright prongs and the cyan face/body panel with cream eyes where visible; infer only the hidden side and back surfaces necessary for the turn. Do not redesign it or add anatomy absent from the supplied image. Keep the existing native 32 by 32 canvas and transparent background. Proposed camera for this trial: eye-level, matching the flat front-facing source; this camera interpretation remains to be checked against the eventual renderer.
name: Robot directional reference trial
